text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"A chance to photobomb! Sneaking in 
quietly... heheh—"

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text:
Ah—! Excuse me! If you stand there, you'll 
be in the shot! Could you please step 
aside?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"...I was caught. That staff member is 
quite sharp."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Photobombing attempt failed, leaving 
Machan feeling rather salty..."
